supernovae-st-nika-crate-admit.description: Prepare and complete a named crate's admission to the Nika workspace under ADR-003. Use only when adding a crate to workspace membership.

supernovae-st-nika-gate-check.description: Audit the evidence for a named crate's 12 admission gates. Use for admission readiness or gate progress, not ordinary code validation.

supernovae-st-nika-agents-nika-nika-auth.description: Author, check and repair Nika projects (.nika workflows, the nika.yaml project file and its beats, supporting files, child workflows) and static NIKA findings. Use migration for existing automation ports and debugging for run failures.

supernovae-st-nika-agents-nika-nika-debu.description: Diagnose failed, paused or suspicious Nika runs from traces. Use for runtime failures, integrity checks and recovery; static workflow edits belong to authoring.

supernovae-st-nika-agents-nika-nika-migr.description: Convert existing scripts, CI jobs or prompt chains into .nika workflows while preserving behavior. Use when an existing automation is being ported.

supernovae-st-nika-agents-nika-nika-oper.description: Prepare existing Nika workflows for unattended operation: budgets, permits, secrets, model changes, CI and trace export. Use for operational changes to a working workflow.

supernovae-st-nika-agents-nika-nika-runn.description: Run, approve, resume and schedule Nika workflows for someone who should not have to read engine output. Use when the user wants a task done again or on a schedule ('every Monday', 'for each file', 'do the same as last time', a batch of items), asks what a workflow will do or cost, wants to run one, or when a run is waiting for an answer. The word Nika does not need to appear.
